'''Proctor of Information Science''' was a position that could be held by a member of the [[Duskhan League]]. The [[Proctor (Yevethan)|proctor]] [[Vor Duull]] advised [[Nil Spaar]] aboard the [[Aramadia (Aramadia-class)|''Aramadia'']].
